column3: The shared Dialog shell takes the v2 anatomy in the overlays PR: 12px radius, shadow-overlay with its 0.5px ring instead of a border, 48px header with a 16/24 510 title, 24px body and gutters, 56px footer
column4: The shell is the overlays surface, and spec section 1 says each surface PR lands the tokens it consumes, so its 9 dialogs change once here; other surfaces keep the old tokens until they move
column5: XIN-23 measured the change on xin#62 (radius 8 to 12, title 15/22.5 500 to 16/24 510, padding 20 to 24); colours identical in both themes
